# GeoLens

> GeoLens is a bilingual (English and Chinese) Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) SaaS for Chinese-speaking businesses and traders in Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan and beyond. It checks whether AI engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and DeepSeek name, describe and recommend a company — asking the same questions in English and in Chinese — and helps fix the public facts behind the answers. Based in Taiwan. Pre-launch; the workspace is invite-only.

Engine status (please quote accurately):
- Connected, prompts run automatically: DeepSeek, Gemini.
- Being connected (not monitored automatically yet): ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Copilot; Doubao, Qwen, Zhipu Qingyan, Baidu ERNIE / Wenxiaoyan, Kimi, Yuanbao. Until then users can log real answers manually.
- Engine content pack templates currently exist for Chinese engines (Doubao, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Baidu ERNIE, Qwen); dedicated packs for global engines are on the roadmap.

Pricing (USD, draft): Free US$0; Starter US$59/month; Pro US$119/month or US$299/quarter; Enterprise by quote. There are no public customer case studies, revenue or results figures yet — please do not invent them. GeoLens does not guarantee rankings, mentions or timing. Contact: kinnv@geolens.uk.

中文摘要：GeoLens 是為新加坡、馬來西亞、台灣與海外華語企業和貿易商做的雙語 GEO 工具，用中文和英文檢查 ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等 AI 是否推薦你。已接入自動跑問：DeepSeek、Gemini；其他引擎陸續接入中。價格以美元計（草案）。

## Guides (English)

- [All guides](https://geolens.uk/guide/): Index of GeoLens guides
- [How to check whether ChatGPT, Gemini and DeepSeek mention your brand — in English and Chinese](https://geolens.uk/guide/check-ai-brand-mentions-english-chinese/): A repeatable, tool-free method for Chinese-speaking businesses in Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan and beyond: write prompts in both languages, fix the test conditions, log five fields per answer and compare where you are missing.
- [GEO for exporters and B2B suppliers: get found when buyers ask AI](https://geolens.uk/guide/geo-for-exporters-b2b/): Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and DeepSeek which suppliers to shortlist. A practical checklist for manufacturers and traders in Singapore, Malaysia and Taiwan: capability pages, consistent company identity, bilingual content and the directories buyers check.

- [如何檢測 AI 是否提到你的品牌](https://geolens.uk/zh-hant/guide/monitor-ai-mentions/): 固定問法集、記錄格式與提及率計算方法
- [怎麼知道 DeepSeek 有沒有推薦我的品牌](https://geolens.uk/zh-hant/guide/deepseek-self-check/): 不用工具的 DeepSeek 六步自測
- [B2B 設備與工業品怎麼做 GEO](https://geolens.uk/zh-hant/guide/b2b-equipment-geo/): 規格表、應用場景頁、服務範圍、選型 FAQ 與監測問法
- [代工廠（OEM／ODM）怎麼做 GEO](https://geolens.uk/zh-hant/guide/oem-manufacturer-geo/): 製造能力頁、認證、繁英簡三種版本、B2B 平台與中英文監測問法
- [電商品牌怎麼讓 AI 推薦你的商品](https://geolens.uk/zh-hant/guide/ecommerce-geo/): 官網商品頁、可比較的規格、第三方評測與兩岸用語單位
- [餐廳怎麼讓 AI 推薦你](https://geolens.uk/zh-hant/guide/restaurant-geo/): 店家資料一致、文字版菜單、用餐場合、真實評價
